learning_outcomes.text: Knows and applies the dimensional and geometric (shape and position) tolerances.
Gains basic knowledge about surface quality and applies surface treatment signs.
Gains knowledge about machine elements such as screw, bolt-nut, washer, stud, key, pin-linkage pin, spring, gear, etc. and performs their assembly and detail drawing applications.
Knows the weld seam symbols and applies them in welded joint drawings.

Acquires knowledge about sliding and rolling contact bearings, as well as auxiliary components such as bushing, retaining ring, shaft lockwasher-locknut, sleeve, seal, lubrication nipple, etc. and perform their assembly drawing applications. 6. Knows and applies rules for assembly and detail drawings.
Knows assembly and part making drawing rules and applies them.
Knows the standard machine elements and drawing tools in the CAD program and uses them to accelerate the mechanical CAD drawings.

syllabus_topics: Dimensional tolerances and fits. CAD applications.
Shape and position tolerances with symbols. CAD applications.
Surface quality and surface finish marks. CAD applications.
Threaded elements: Screws, bolts-nuts, washers, studs.
Threaded elements: Screws, bolts-nuts, washers, studs. Assembly applications with threaded fasteners in CAD environment.
Key, pins-linkage pins and springs. CAD applications.
Keys, pins-linkage pins and springs. CAD applications.
Weld symbols and weldments. CAD applications.
CAD applications associated with the welding of structural elements.
Sliding and rolling contact bearings and auxiliary components such as bushing, retaining ring, shaft lockwasher-locknut, sleeve, seal, lubrication nipple, etc. CAD applications.
Gears: Spur, helical, bevel gears, worm gear, rack and pinion gear. CAD applications.
Assembly and detail drawings. CAD applications.
